{{Quote|According to my operatives, the Tierfon Sector Fleet isn't planning to launch their attack for three weeks but the new Fleet Admiral Tzenkens is supposedly a real firebrand: he might push the thing ahead to keep us hopping.|Chief of Intelligence Vernan, 251st Meeting of the Alliance High Command|<ref name="251st" />}}
[[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] '''Tzenkens''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in charge of the [[Tierfon Sector Fleet]]. He took command of the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the wake of the [[Tocan system disaster]], and aimed to have it rested and refitted for action against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in three [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]].<ref name="251st" />
